info.name: RDPMS API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Remote Diagnostic & Predictive Maintenance System — RDSO/SPN/257/2025

**Setup:**
1. Set `base_url` = `http://3.6.93.103`
2. Run 'Login' → access_token auto-saved
3. Set `api_key` for Webhook/SSE endpoints

request.description: Links a discovered para_id to an asset, location box, slave card and channel.
Open in browser or EventSource. Stream: initial → update → heartbeat events.

WebSocket endpoints cannot be called from Postman HTTP tab.

Use Postman's WebSocket tab or a browser console:

**Telemetry:** ws://{{base_url}}/ws/telemetry/{station_code}?asset_no=PT-101
**Alerts:**    ws://{{base_url}}/ws/alerts/{station_code}?alert_type=all
**Health:**    ws://{{base_url}}/ws/health/{station_code}

After connecting, send: {"type":"pong"} to respond to heartbeats.

See websocket.md for full message protocol.
